response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with strong testing culture and some tooling background, but the resume shows minimal Java exposure, no Kotlin, no Spring or enterprise JVM framework experience, and no substantial JVM ecosystem work — all core requirements for this role. His depth lies in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang rather than enterprise Java/Kotlin tooling, making him a poor fit despite genuine seniority.
strengths: Prior IDE development experience on NI LabWindows/CVI (C/C++ IDE components)
Strong developer-tooling background (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure)
Long track record across complex systems, including low-latency high-throughput services
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin experience and only incidental Java usage
No Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM framework experience
Recent work centers on TypeScript/Node full-stack, not JVM or language tooling
